Container.Name: Valheim-Kartograph
Container.Overview: Valheim Kartograph is a self-hosted collaborative mapping tool for Valheim. Draw biomes, paths, markers and notes on a shared no-map world, with realtime updates across multiple devices.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Valheim map mapping cartography no-map collaborative
Container.Requires: No built-in authentication. Use only on a trusted/private network unless protected by an external authentication layer. Persistent data is stored in the configured appdata directory.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Valheim Kartograph web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database and application data.
